authority: User requested factual accuracy reassessment; supplemental basic world-knowledge check, separate from completed supplied-fact assessment.
scope: 15 stable elementary facts per model, five three-turn conversations. No teacher, retrieval, training, selection or historical-clock changes.
scoring: Manual semantic correctness for complete direct answers; word/digit equivalents accepted; unrelated extra factual claims rejected. Do not pool with provided-fact grounding totals.
limitations: Tiny primary-authored basic-fact check, not a representative knowledge benchmark. Added after primary supplied-fact review; separately frozen before supplementary inference.
